description: For aos configuration files that use $ref/$env (for plain data use json_search). Same as json_search plus: follow: true goes through $ref on the way to the place, resolve: true searches the value with $ref/$env resolved. Hits are paths you can read with jsonx_get and follow: true. up does not work with follow or resolve. Example: {"path": "tools.json", "key": "env", "resolve": true}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/jsonx_search.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

follow.description: true = go through $ref on the way to the place

resolve.description: true = look at the value with $ref/$env resolved (default: as written)

contains.description: true = substring match for key and string values (case-sensitive)

up.description: true = search the ancestors' own keys, nearest level first, instead of everything below

limit.description: at most this many hits (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_ITEMS, else 200)
